create_utils_instance: create a Utils instance with custom host and port for the image serving service
save_image_tensor: save a torch tensor image as a PNG file and return its public URL
save_image_pil: save a PIL image to the temp images directory and return its accessible URL
build_image_service: build a Utils instance that manages image and video temp directories for async server
test_save_image: test the save_image method with a torch tensor to verify PNG output and URL return
